scope: Read-only profiling/background and launch-history audit; no benchmarks or host changes
limits: Shell commands have no per-command timestamps or exit output. Saved file dates are upper bounds only.
Editor save proves source content at save time; original timing sequence independently supports workload selection/order.
Inferred preparation gap is next result completion minus its elapsed time minus previous completion; includes any untimed work or pause, not attributable to a particular setup command.
No historical zone/buddy or process snapshot proves allocator fragmentation or profiling overlap.
